meta.name: babysit
meta.description: Watch a pull request or review cycle until it is ready to merge. Use when asked to babysit, monitor, or keep checking PR comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 持续监控 PR 直到所有问题解决可合并
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要盯着 PR 等待审核通过或 CI 通过
copy.tagline_en: Monitor pull requests until all issues are resolved and ready to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to watch PRs until reviews and CI pass

howto.what: Claude 会持续盯住一个 PR:轮询 CI 检查,读取新评论和未解决的 review 线程,修掉真实问题并推送提交,直到检查通过、没有待处理评论和未解决线程才停下。
howto.when: 当你让它 babysit、盯着或持续检查某个 PR 的评论、评审和 CI,直到所有可处理问题都解决时触发。

say.text: 盯着 PR #123,直到 CI 通过、评论都处理完
say.note: 会轮询检查,修复后推送再复查

say.text: babysit 这个 PR,有未解决的 review 线程就修掉
say.note: 验证修复后才会把线程标为已解决

say.text: 每 2 分钟看一次这个 PR 的评论和 CI 状态
say.note: 按你指定的频率轮询,默认 30-60 秒

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude watches a pull request until it's clean: it polls CI checks, reads new comments and unresolved review threads, fixes real issues, pushes, and repeats until all actionable items are resolved.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to babysit, monitor, or keep checking a PR's comments, reviews, and CI until all actionable issues are resolved.

say_en.text: Babysit PR #123 until CI passes and all comments are handled
say_en.note: It polls checks, fixes issues, then pushes

say_en.text: Watch this PR and fix any unresolved review threads
say_en.note: Threads are resolved only after the fix is verified

say_en.text: Check this PR's comments and CI every 2 minutes
say_en.note: Polls at your cadence; default is 30-60 seconds
